## Checklist

- [ ] I made this profile or have the right to share it, including all images in it.
- [ ] I removed private data (paths, names, tokens, passwords) before export.
- [ ] `profile.json` `id` equals the folder name and `author` equals my GitHub user name.
- [ ] For an update: I raised `version` in `profile.json`.
- [ ] I did not change `index.json` or anything outside my own folder.
